texts.name: Sandel
texts.biography: Sandel was just a warrior without any particular talents, his only strength was his self-belief. When he saw the Couatls arrive at the Factory, he immediately understood that this was his chance to become someone important. Without hesitation, he began training them...

specialty.name: Couatls
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Couatls, Crimson Couatls and Quetzalcouatls by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
